# Data Engineering
## Load Libraries and Datasets

```{r libraries}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(labelled)
library(psych)
library(broom)
hsls_raw <- read_dta("hsls_17_student_pets_sr_v1_0.dta")
names(hsls_raw) <- tolower(names(hsls_raw))
```

## Create Analytic Sample

```{r subset-missing}
hsls_na <- hsls_raw

# select relevant variables
#hsls_na <- hsls_na %>% select(stu_id, starts_with("x1"), starts_with("p1"), x3thimath9, starts_with("w1par"), starts_with("m1"), starts_with("n1"))

# replace missing values
hsls_na[hsls_na == -9] <- NA
hsls_na[hsls_na == -8] <- NA
hsls_na[hsls_na == -7] <- NA
hsls_na[hsls_na == -6] <- NA
hsls_na[hsls_na == -5] <- NA

# filter out variables where more than 10% is missing
## hsls_na <- hsls_na %>% dplyr::select(where(~mean(is.na(.)) <= 0.10))
```

## Variable Manipulation
```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Outcome variable
# ---------------------------
# par_says_honors: binary numeric (0/1)
hsls <- hsls_na %>%
  mutate(
    par_says_honors = case_when(
      p1honors == 1 ~ "1 yes",
      p1honors == 0 ~ "0 no",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Treatment variables
# ---------------------------
hsls <- hsls %>%
  mutate(
    # adv_math: binary numeric (0 = not advanced, 1 = advanced)
    adv_math = case_when(
      x3thimath9 <= 4 ~ "1 yes",
      x3thimath9 >= 5 ~ "0 no"
    ),

    # math_3level: ordinal categorical (low → high)
    math_3level = ordered(
      case_when(
        x3thimath9 <= 3 ~ "1 remedial",
        x3thimath9 == 4 ~ "2 on-level",
        x3thimath9 >= 5 ~ "3 advanced"
      ),
      levels = c("1 remedial", "2 on-level", "3 advanced")
    ),

    # math_4level: ordinal categorical (low → high)
    math_4level = ordered(
      case_when(
        x3thimath9 <= 3 ~ "1 remedial",
        x3thimath9 == 4 ~ "2 on-level",
        x3thimath9 == 5 ~ "3 advanced",
        x3thimath9 >= 6 ~ "4 double advanced"
      ),
      levels = c("1 remedial", "2 on-level", 
                 "3 advanced", "4 double advanced")
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Controls
# ---------------------------
hsls <- hsls %>%
  mutate(
    # urban: binary numeric
    urban = ifelse(x1locale == 1, "1 urban", "0 non-urban"),

    # math_score: continuous numeric
    math_score = ifelse(x1txmquint < 0, NA, x1txmtscor),

    # public: binary numeric (1 = public, 0 = private)
    public = case_when(
      x1control == 1 ~ "1 public",
      x1control == 2 ~ "0 private"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Demographics
# ---------------------------
hsls <- hsls %>%
  mutate(
    # first_gen: binary numeric
    first_gen = ifelse(x1paredu <= 3, 1,0),
    par_ba = ifelse(x1paredu >= 4, 1, 0),

    # female: binary numeric (1 = female)
    female = ifelse(x1sex == 2, 1, 0),

    # frpl: binary numeric
    frpl = ifelse(x1poverty185 == 0, "0 no", "1 yes"),

    # pov_level: ordinal numeric (1 = deepest poverty → 4 = no poverty)
    pov_level = ordered(
      case_when(
        x1poverty185 == 0  ~ 4,
        x1poverty185 == 1 & x1poverty130 == 0 ~ 3,
        x1poverty130 == 1 & x1poverty == 0 ~ 2,
        x1poverty == 1 ~ 1
      ),
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4)
    ),

    # first_lang: nominal categorical
    first_lang = factor(
      case_when(
        x1duallang == 1 ~ "English only",
        x1duallang == 2 ~ "Non-English only",
        x1duallang == 3 ~ "English and another equally"
      )
    ),

    # esl_program: binary numeric
    esl_program = case_when(
      p1ellever == 1 ~ "1 yes",
      p1ellever == 2 ~ "0 no"
    ),

    # stud_race: nominal categorical
    stud_race = factor(
      case_when(
        x1race %in% c(1, 7) ~ "Indigenous",
        x1race == 2        ~ "Asian",
        x1race == 3        ~ "Black",
        x1race %in% c(4,5) ~ "Latinx",
        x1race == 6        ~ "Multiple",
        x1race == 8        ~ "White"
      )
    ),

    # par_race: nominal categorical
    par_race = factor(
      case_when(
        x1par1race == 2        ~ "Asian",
        x1par1race == 3        ~ "Black",
        x1par1race %in% c(4,5) ~ "Latinx",
        x1par1race == 6        ~ "Multiple",
        x1par1race == 8        ~ "White",
        x1par1race == 9        ~ "Indigenous"
      )
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Parent involvement
# ---------------------------
hsls <- hsls %>%
  mutate(
    # par_mtg: binary numeric
    par_mtg = ifelse((p1ptomtg == 1 | p1schmtg == 1), 1, 0),

    # par_sch_inv: count variable (numeric, Poisson-type)
    par_sch_inv = par_mtg +
                  p1counselor +
                  p1schevent +
                  p1volunteer +
                  p1fundraise +
                  p1ptconfer
  )

# ---------------------------
# Parent expectations
# ---------------------------
hsls <- hsls %>%
  mutate(
    exp_ba = ifelse(p1eduexpect >= 6, 1, 0),
    # par_exp: ordinal numeric (low → high expectations)
    par_exp = ordered(
      case_when(
        p1eduexpect == 11            ~ 1,
        p1eduexpect %in% c(1,2,3,4)  ~ 2,
        p1eduexpect %in% c(5,6)      ~ 3,
        p1eduexpect %in% c(7,8)      ~ 4,
        p1eduexpect %in% c(9,10)     ~ 5
      ),
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
    )
  )

# check poverty groups
##hsls %>% dplyr::select(pov_level, starts_with("x1pov")) %>% gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = pov_level)

# ---------------------------
# Teacher Variables
# ---------------------------
deficit <- hsls %>% dplyr::select(m1family, m1discipline, m1stuachieve, m1parent)
reliability(deficit)

library(EFAtools)
math_focus <- hsls %>% dplyr::select(m1interest, m1concepts, m1algorithm, m1compskills, m1problem, m1reason, m1ideas, m1prepare, m1logic, m1history, m1explain, m1business, m1compute, m1test)

math_rigor <- hsls %>% dplyr::select(m1problem, m1reason, m1ideas, m1logic, m1history, m1explain)
reliability(math_rigor)
KMO(math_rigor)

math_basic <- hsls %>% dplyr::select(m1algorithm, m1compskills, m1compute, m1test)
reliability(math_basic)
KMO(math_basic)
```

```{r}
library(lavaan)

## deficit framing
m1 <- 'deficit =~ m1family+  m1discipline + m1stuachieve + m1parent'
deficit_cfa <- cfa(m1, data = hsls, )
summary(deficit_cfa)

sem_model <- '
deficit =~ m1family +  m1discipline + m1stuachieve + m1parent
rigor =~ m1problem + m1reason +  m1ideas
basic =~ m1algorithm + m1compskills + m1compute + m1test
x3tcredmat ~ deficit + rigor + basic + par_sch_inv + exp_ba + frpl + par_ba + female + math_score + adv_math
rigor	~	x3tcredmat
rigor	~	math_score
rigor ~ adv_math
'
fit <- sem(sem_model, data = hsls)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE)
modindices(fit, sort = TRUE)
```

# Save Clean Dataset

```{r save}
write_dta(hsls, "hsls_subset.dta")
```
